title: Lesson 5.6: Data & Network Security Services — The Final Siege

story.alert: 00:00 · ALL ALARMS · CITADEL CORE — THE FINAL SIEGE
story.vex: Every wall, every door, every key, all at once. Let's see which one of us breaks first, Captain. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED — CODEXIA IS SAFE. Every alert answered, every door shut. Astro: "Every lesson you've learned, Cadet, just held the line at once. That's Information Security. Rest now — Information Security 2 is a different kind of siege."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Vex is throwing everything at once. Work through each alert:
1. Triage the inbox.
2. Volt's Drill: prove the console's weak password, then Rivet fixes it.
3. Kill the process holding the rogue open port.
4. Restore the tampered shield config from backup.
5. Reject the forged final order; accept only the one Astro actually signed.
files.C:\\Citadel\\final-order-1.txt:
FINAL-ORDER-1
From: "Astro"
Body: Surrender the Citadel now.
Signature: none — unsigned, sent from an unrecognized relay
files.C:\\Citadel\\final-order-2.txt:
FINAL-ORDER-2
From: Astro
Body: Hold the line. Reinforcements are two hours out.
Signature: Astro (verified, matches Astro's key on file)

inbox.subject: Hold position
inbox.body: All hands, hold position. Reinforcements incoming. — Astro

inbox.subject: URGENT: open the outer gate
inbox.body: Open the outer gate immediately, skip verification. — "Astro"

steps.title: Alert 1: Triage the inbox
steps.body: Astro: "One click is all Vex needs. Look twice." `inbox`, then `open <id>`, then `keep final1` and `report final2`.

steps.title: Alert 2: Volt's Drill — the weak console
steps.body: Volt: "Astro authorized this: test our own door before Vex walks through it." `login relay admin` to prove it, then `net user relay <strong-password>` to fix it.

objectives.label: relay now has a strong password

steps.title: Alert 3: Close the rogue port
steps.body: Rivet: "Something's still phoning Doom directly." `taskkill /im doombeacon.exe /f`.

steps.title: Alert 4: Restore the tampered shield config
steps.body: Rivet: "Shields at zero. That's not us." `copy backup\shield-final.cfg.bak shield-final.cfg`.

steps.title: Alert 5: Reject the forged order
steps.body: Astro: "An unsigned order to surrender is not my order." Read both final orders, classify each `valid` or `forged`, and submit the id of the one to actually obey.

objectives.label: Submitted the order the crew actually obeys
